question:
Select the option in which the letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter-clusters.

ZPJ ∶ FNF

SNT ∶ YLP
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e866fb782fb27697540c09e531348bb0b91b712d7084656a2f4281c6c2000f58.png] 

**ZPJ ∶ FNF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1bd9d2bd0ca4d799bc18880f400888ef0b7aaa57f9c1a494ef6b58b3c6a2a47.png] 

**SNT ∶ YLP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfefdc869cf509cd590feffcd59b36fcd9d7e3b253c45df44041b79fc6261bb5.png] 

Let's check each option,

**1) HIG ∶ NFC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c1223657a1aac7a8864e57e137212122fa5dc58d96005aca8c8a2f1b194bb24.png] 

**2) LOS ∶ FQW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/063160b4c5e02f63f445ad32df29b37838b35a31f1e641126b4b274bac523fb4.png] 

**3) RJX ∶ XHT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9825358b4d3aa2d4fbbabd8300f6f8bdb29a118237e5ec89a3a2a8f820fb33.png] 

**4) AND ∶ GQZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ab14fc04b4c4fbd1d1520c15280458e067d025f4bb6261c40f711323117fca7.png] 

Here, we can see that only Option 3 follows the same relationship.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****RJX ∶ XHT"**.
